channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Charming cottage ripe for renovation has gone up for sale for £325,000
item.description: A charming cottage in sought after Hursley ripe for renovation has gone up for sale for £325,000.

item.title: Why CPS dropped rape charge for man who paid to sexually abuse girl in park
item.description: The rape charge against a man who paid to have sex with a teen in a park was dropped because the lesser charge "more appropriately reflected crime", says Crown Prosecution Service (CPS)

item.title: England football legend's residency on board P&O Cruises Britannia announced
item.description: P&O Cruises will welcome England football legend Sir Geoff Hurst on Britannia this spring for a four night 'audience with' residency.

item.title: Fresh backlash from MP, councillors and residents over new Pear Tree housing bid
item.description: A fresh wave of opposition has been shared over renewed plans to build six homes next to The Pear Tree pub in Boorley Green.

item.title: Hilarious homage to Fawlty Towers taking Southampton by storm
item.description: Yet John Cleese's stage revival of Fawlty Towers at Mayflower Theatre, Southampton, is the ideal nostalgia-soaked farce masterclass.

item.title: New policing team and £340,000 funding announced for Hampshire road safety
item.description: A six-figure investment in road safety and a new Hampshire road policing team have been announced by PCC Donna Jones.

item.title: Ofsted inspectors praise college’s inclusive culture and support for learners
item.description: Richard Taunton Sixth Form College’s inclusive culture and support for its learners has been praised by Ofsted inspectors in a new report.

item.title: New bin collection scheme set to be expanded - here's where
item.description: A council is preparing to roll out the third and final phase of a new waste collection system in the New Forest

item.title: Southampton pub closed as it undergoes six-figure refurbishment
item.description: A Southampton pub has temporarily closed for a six-figure refurbishment that promises to revitalise the venue's interior and garden by Easter.

item.title: Organiser of children's party sentenced for concealing sex offender status
item.description: A prominent LGBTQ+ advocate organised a boy's birthday party without telling all the parents he was the subject of a sexual harm prevention order
